title: LEGO: A Lifting-Free Approach for Exocentric-to-Egocentric Video Generation
title_zh: LEGO: 一种无需重建的exo-to-ego视频生成方法

paragraphs.en: Generating an egocentric video from a single exocentric recording is a challenging case of novel view synthesis, as the two cameras share little overlap and much of the target view is unobserved. Current state-of-the-art methods reconstruct the scene explicitly by estimating depth, lifting the video into a point cloud, and re-rendering it from the egocentric camera to condition a video diffusion model. This deterministic mapping assigns each pixel to a single reprojected location, which preserves texture but translates depth errors into misplaced content. We ask what a video diffusion model should receive as its condition and propose a lifting-free answer: a learned view synthesizer, an LVSM-style transformer fine-tuned to render the egocentric view directly without depth, point clouds, or reprojection, resolving cross-view correspondence internally. In contrast, its probabilistic mapping averages each region over candidate source locations according to a learned correspondence distribution, preserving structure while fine texture is averaged away. We argue that this trade-off suits a diffusion generator, whose denoising training excels at restoring detail, so an effective condition should prioritize structural alignment over sharpness. This distribution’s concentration also yields a per-region confidence, used both to mask low-confidence regions and to guide the generator toward high-confidence areas during early layout-forming denoising steps. Our approach consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art explicit pipeline and generalizes to other datasets without retraining. The synthesizer thus supplies view structure, and the diffusion model its detail.

paragraphs.en: We study exocentric-to-egocentric video generation: given a single third-person recording of a scene and a target egocentric camera trajectory, the goal is to synthesize the video a camera following this trajectory would capture. The task matters wherever first-person data is scarce and third-person footage abundant ( Grauman et al., 2024 ) , and it is demanding: the two views share little content, so much of the target must be synthesized rather than copied. Existing methods condition implicitly on exocentric features ( Luo et al., 2024b ; Cheng et al., 2024 ) ; assume privileged inputs such as surrounding cameras ( Liu et al., 2024a ) , rich multimodal observations ( Park et al., 2026 ) , or a ground-truth egocentric first frame ( Xu et al., 2025 ) ; or reconstruct the scene explicitly. The current state of the art ( Kang et al., 2026 ) takes the explicit route, conditioning a video diffusion model ( Wan et al., 2025 ) on a point-cloud render obtained by lifting the exocentric video with monocular depth and replaying it from the egocentric trajectory. This route inherits the errors of the estimated depth: depth errors misplace the content of the point-cloud render, sharply and without any signal of where it is wrong.

paragraphs.en: The design follows from the paper’s central question: what should a video diffusion model be given as its condition? The two renders fail in opposite ways. The point-cloud render is deterministic: each pixel is assigned a single reprojected location, so its errors are misplaced content. The synthesizer’s render is probabilistic: each region averages over candidate source locations according to a learned correspondence distribution, so its errors are blur. These failures are not equally costly: blur is the corruption that denoising training teaches the generator to undo, and diffusion models routinely recover sharp detail from blurred inputs ( Saharia et al., 2023 ; Ho et al., 2022 ; Meng et al., 2022 ) , whereas rough or misplaced conditions have needed dedicated mechanisms to relax them ( Liu et al., 2024b ; Seo et al., 2024 ) . We therefore argue that a condition should be judged by alignment first and sharpness second, since the generator supplies the second far more readily than the first: the condition should say where things are, and the generator will decide how they look. The correspondence distribution supplies a further signal for this: its concentration at each region is a confidence, and we mask from the conditioning those regions where it is low.
paragraphs.zh: 这一设计源于论文的核心问题：视频扩散模型应接收何种条件输入？ 这两种渲染结果以相反的方式失败了。 点云渲染是确定性的：每个像素都被分配一个唯一的重投影位置，因此其错误表现为内容错位。 合成器的渲染是概率性的：每个区域根据学习到的对应关系分布，对候选源位置进行平均，因此其错误表现为模糊。 这些失败并非代价相同：模糊是去噪训练所教会生成器需要消除的失真，而扩散模型通常能从模糊输入中恢复清晰细节（Saharia et al., 2023；Ho et al., 2022；Meng et al., 2022）；相比之下，粗糙或错位的条件则需要专门的机制来缓解问题（Liu et al., 2024b；Seo et al., 2024）。 因此我们认为，条件应首先依据对齐性进行评判，其次才是清晰度，因为生成器更容易实现后者而非前者：条件应说明事物的位置，而生成器将决定它们的外观。 对应关系分布为此提供了进一步的信号：它在每个区域的集中程度代表了一种置信度，我们会从条件输入中屏蔽掉置信度较低的区域。

paragraphs.en: On Ego-Exo4D, the synthesizer’s render outperforms the point-cloud render as a condition, ARC at inference alone outperforms the depth-derived attention bias with which prior work trains the generator, and the full system outperforms the state-of-the-art explicit pipeline on seen and unseen scenes; the same weights also generalize to EgoHumans and Nymeria without retraining.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Ego-Exo4D 上，合成器的渲染结果作为条件时优于点云渲染；仅通过推理阶段的 ARC 就优于先前工作用于训练生成器的深度衍生注意力偏差；而完整系统在已见和未见场景中的表现均优于当前最先进的显式流程。此外，同一组权重无需重新训练即可泛化到 EgoHumans 和 Nymeria。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are: (1) LEGO , a lifting-free exocentric-to-egocentric video generation framework that conditions a video diffusion model on the confidence-gated render of a learned view synthesizer instead of a point-cloud reconstruction; (2) evidence that a structurally aligned but soft condition serves the generator better than a sharp but misplaced one; (3) ARC, training-free guidance that reuses the synthesizer’s confidence to steer the early denoising steps toward its render; and (4) state-of-the-art results on Ego-Exo4D and generalization to EgoHumans and Nymeria without retraining.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献包括：(1) LEGO，一种无需抬升的从外视角到第一人称视角的视频生成框架，该框架通过一个学习到的视图合成器的置信度门控渲染结果来约束视频扩散模型，而非依赖点云重建；(2) 证据表明，结构对齐但柔和的条件比结构清晰但位置错误的条件更能有效服务于生成器；(3) ARC，一种无需训练的引导方法，它复用视图合成器的置信度信息，以引导早期去噪步骤朝向其渲染结果发展；以及 (4) 在 Ego-Exo4D 数据集上取得当前最优结果，并能在无需重新训练的情况下推广到 EgoHumans 和 Nymeria。

paragraphs.en: Early systems relied on privileged inputs: surrounding cameras ( Liu et al., 2024a ) , rich multimodal exocentric observations ( Park et al., 2026 ) , or the ground-truth egocentric first frame ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . Others condition implicitly on exocentric features ( Luo et al., 2024b ; Cheng et al., 2024 ) . The state of the art, EgoX ( Kang et al., 2026 ) , takes a single exocentric video and reconstructs the scene explicitly: depth from a video pose engine ( Huang et al., 2025a ) lifts the frames into a point cloud, which is re-rendered along the egocentric trajectory to condition a video diffusion model ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , and the generator is trained with a depth-derived attention bias. paragraphs.en: Novel view synthesis has moved from per-scene optimization to feed-forward models that predict radiance fields, 3D Gaussians, or triplanes in a single pass ( Yu et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Charatan et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) ; LVSM ( Jin et al., 2025 ) maps posed input tokens to target-ray tokens with a plain transformer. Rendering supervision is known to teach geometry: photometric view synthesis losses made monocular depth learnable without ground truth ( Garg et al., 2016 ; Zhou et al., 2017 ) . Self-supervised and diffusion features likewise acquire correspondence they were never supervised for ( Caron et al., 2021 ; Amir et al., 2022 ; Tang et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2023 ) . We rely on the same effect in a synthesizer fine-tuned for the exocentric-to-egocentric view change: its render serves as the generator’s condition, and the concentration of its correspondence distribution as a per-region confidence (Section 3.2 ).

paragraphs.en: Conditional diffusion models recover fine detail from coarse inputs: super-resolution and cascaded generation upsample low-resolution images, and blurring the condition during training helps rather than hurts ( Saharia et al., 2023 ; Ho et al., 2022 ) ; SDEdit synthesizes realistic images from stroke layouts ( Meng et al., 2022 ) ; GeNVS produces sharp novel views from a volume-rendered feature image ( Chan et al., 2023 ) ; and blur can serve as the forward corruption a diffusion model learns to invert ( Rissanen et al., 2023 ; Hoogeboom and Salimans, 2023 ) , with coarse structure decided at high noise and detail at low noise ( Choi et al., 2022 ; Rissanen et al., 2023 ) . Conversely, precise conditions are neither required nor always safe: layout-level depth suffices for depth-conditioned control ( Bhat et al., 2024 ) , control must be relaxed where a rough condition is wrong ( Liu et al., 2024b ) , and generation from a depth-based reprojection must learn where to trust it ( Seo et al., 2024 ) . We read these results as favoring a condition that is aligned before it is sharp.
paragraphs.zh: 条件扩散模型能够从粗略输入中恢复精细细节：超分辨率和级联生成可提升低分辨率图像的采样精度，而训练过程中对条件进行模糊处理反而有助于而非阻碍效果（Saharia 等，2023；Ho 等，2022）；SDEdit 能够根据笔触布局合成逼真的图像（Meng 等，2022）；GeNVS 可从体积渲染的特征图像中生成清晰的新视角（Chan 等，2023）；此外，模糊还可以作为扩散模型需要学习逆转的前向失真过程（Rissanen 等，2023；Hoogeboom 和 Salimans，2023），其中粗略结构由高噪声阶段决定，而细节则由低噪声阶段决定（Choi 等，2022；Rissanen 等，2023）。 相反，精确的条件既非必需，也非始终安全：布局级别的深度信息足以实现基于深度的控制（Bhat 等，2024）；当粗略条件错误时，必须放宽控制（Liu 等，2024b）；而基于深度的重投影生成过程则必须学会判断哪些部分值得信赖（Seo 等，2024）。 我们将这些结果解读为：在条件变得精确之前，其方向性的一致性更为重要。

paragraphs.en: Pretrained diffusion models can be steered at sampling time: ILVR ( Choi et al., 2021 ) , RePaint ( Lugmayr et al., 2022 ) , and Blended Diffusion ( Avrahami et al., 2022 ) blend a reference into the intermediate sample; DDRM ( Kawar et al., 2022 ) and DDNM ( Wang et al., 2023 ) project each step onto measurement-consistent solutions; DPS ( Chung et al., 2023 ) , MCG ( Chung et al., 2022 ) , and FreeDoM ( Yu et al., 2023 ) apply guidance gradients. paragraphs.en: We follow the input setting of EgoX ( Kang et al., 2026 ) : a single exocentric video with its camera calibration, and a target egocentric camera trajectory along which the video is to be generated. All experiments use the same image-to-video diffusion backbone and canvas formulation as EgoX, in which the exocentric and egocentric views are concatenated along the width and the egocentric half of the conditioning latent carries the condition for the target view. Prior work fills this conditioning input with a point-cloud render and, in addition, trains the generator with a depth-derived bias on the cross-view attention. LEGO fills it with the render of a frozen view synthesizer (Section 3.1 ), gates the render by the confidence of the synthesizer’s correspondence distribution (Section 3.2 ), and uses the same confidence to guide the early denoising steps toward the render (Section 3.3 ). The pipeline is lifting-free: no depth is estimated and no point cloud is built at any stage. We do not modify the generator. We change the condition it receives and how it is sampled (Fig. 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们遵循 EgoX（Kang 等人，2026）的输入设置：一个外视角视频及其相机校准信息，以及一条目标内视角相机轨迹，视频将沿着该轨迹生成。 所有实验均使用与 EgoX 相同的图像到视频扩散主干网络和画布构建方式，其中外视角和内视角沿宽度方向拼接，而条件潜在变量的内视角部分则携带目标视角的条件信息。 先前的工作用点云渲染结果填充这一条件输入，并额外通过深度推导出的偏差来训练生成器在跨视角注意力中的表现。 LEGO 用冻结视角合成器的渲染结果填充该输入（第 3.1 节），通过合成器对应关系分布的置信度对渲染结果进行门控（第 3.2 节），并利用相同的置信度引导早期去噪步骤向该渲染结果靠拢（第 3.3 节）。 该流程无需提升操作：在任何阶段都不会估计深度或构建点云。 我们没有修改生成器。 我们改变了其接收的条件以及采样方式（图 2）。

paragraphs.en: The two mappings fail differently. The explicit mapping assigns each target pixel a single source pixel, which keeps texture sharp but translates a depth error directly into misplaced content; in statistical terms, its error is a bias. The learned mapping averages over the candidate sources in p 𝐮 p_{\mathbf{u}} , which blurs texture wherever the distribution is spread out but keeps content close to its correct place; its error is a variance. Denoising training makes the generator well suited to restoring detail ( Saharia et al., 2023 ; Ho et al., 2022 ; Chan et al., 2023 ) , so blur is the failure it is best equipped to correct, whereas conditions that are sharp but misplaced have required dedicated mechanisms to relax or override them ( Liu et al., 2024b ; Seo et al., 2024 ) . This is why we condition on F F ’s render rather than on the point-cloud render; Section 4 tests the choice, and Fig. 3 contrasts the two pipelines.
paragraphs.zh: 这两种映射的失效方式不同。 显式映射为每个目标像素分配一个唯一的源像素，这能保持纹理清晰，但会将深度误差直接转化为内容错位；从统计学角度看，其误差是一种偏差。 学习到的映射会对 p 𝐮 p_{\mathbf{u}} 中的候选源进行平均处理，这会在分布扩散的区域使纹理变得模糊，但能保持内容接近其正确位置；其误差是一种方差。 去噪训练使生成器非常适合恢复细节（Saharia 等人，2023；Ho 等人，2022；Chan 等人，2023），因此模糊是它最能纠正的失效类型，而清晰但错位的情况则需要专门的机制来放宽或覆盖这些条件（Liu 等人，2024b；Seo 等人，2024）。 这就是为什么我们以 F F 的渲染结果作为条件，而不是点云渲染结果；第 4 节检验了这一选择，而图 3 对比了这两种流程。

paragraphs.en: The published LVSM checkpoint, which we call the untuned synthesizer, is trained to interpolate between nearby pinhole views, whereas our target is an extrapolation to a fisheye headset camera that shares little overlap with the source. Because every camera-specific quantity enters F F through the ray map, no architectural change is needed: we invert the calibrated fisheye projection per pixel to obtain the target rays, and fine-tune all of its weights on exocentric-egocentric pairs, supervised by the raw fisheye recordings. Supervising on real recordings also teaches F F where the lens does not see, which the ray map alone cannot express (Appendix C.3 ). The fine-tuning is cheap, 10,000 steps or about 3.5 hours on four NVIDIA H200 GPUs, and F F is frozen afterwards.
paragraphs.zh: 我们称之为“未调优合成器”的已发布 LVSM 检查点，其训练目标是插值邻近针孔视图之间的过渡；而我们的目标则是外推至一个鱼眼头戴式摄像头，该摄像头与源数据几乎没有重叠。 由于每个摄像头特定的量都通过射线映射进入 F F，因此无需任何架构改动：我们对每个像素反转校准后的鱼眼投影以获得目标射线，并在外心-内心成对数据上微调其所有权重，同时以原始鱼眼记录作为监督信号。 使用真实记录进行监督还能教会 F F 镜头无法观测到的区域，这是仅靠射线映射无法表达的（附录 C.3）。 微调过程成本较低：在四块 NVIDIA H200 GPU 上运行约 10,000 步，耗时大约 3.5 小时，之后 F F 将被冻结。

paragraphs.en: The gated render enters the generator as its conditioning input. Prior work additionally steers the generator with a depth-derived bias on cross-view attention, applied throughout training. We instead act on the denoising trajectory at inference time: during the early steps, in which the layout of the sample is determined ( Choi et al., 2022 ; Rissanen et al., 2023 ) , the generator’s current estimate of the clean video is moved toward the render in proportion to the confidence, and the remaining steps are left unconstrained. We call this Adaptive Rendering Consistency (ARC).
paragraphs.zh: 带门控的渲染结果作为条件输入进入生成器。 先前的工作还通过在跨视图注意力中引入源自深度的偏差来引导生成器，并在整个训练过程中应用该偏差。 我们则在推理阶段对去噪轨迹进行操作：在早期步骤中（此时样本的布局已确定（Choi et al., 2022；Rissanen et al., 2023）），生成器对干净视频的当前估计值会根据置信度比例向渲染结果靠拢，而其余步骤则不受约束。 我们将其称为自适应渲染一致性（ARC）。

paragraphs.en: We train and evaluate on Ego-Exo4D ( Grauman et al., 2024 ) following the protocol of EgoX ( Kang et al., 2026 ) . The benchmark has two test splits: seen , whose scenes appear in the training set, and unseen , whose scenes do not. PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, CLIP-I, and FVD are computed on the generated egocentric frames, and the VBench scores for temporal flickering (TF), motion smoothness (MS), and dynamic degree (DD) on the full exocentric–egocentric canvas. We compare with the numbers reported in Kang et al. (2026) and with the released EgoX checkpoint rerun under our evaluation code, denoted EgoX † . For a fair comparison, all ablations use the same backbone, LoRA rank, training schedule, random seed, and camera trajectories. They differ only in the conditioning input and in how denoising is guided. Implementation details, the evaluation protocol, and object-level metrics are given in Appendices A , B.1 , and B.3 , respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 我们遵循 EgoX（Kang 等人，2026）的方案，在 Ego-Exo4D（Grauman 等人，2024）上进行训练和评估。该基准包含两个测试分集：seen（已见），其场景出现在训练集中；以及 unseen（未见），其场景未出现在训练集中。我们在生成的以自我为中心的画面帧上计算 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS、CLIP-I 和 FVD，并在完整的以外部为中心–以自我为中心的画布上计算 VBench 的时间闪烁（TF）、运动平滑度（MS）和动态程度（DD）分数。我们将结果与 Kang 等人（2026）报告的数据进行比较，并与使用我们的评估代码重新运行的已发布的 EgoX 检查点进行比较（记为 EgoX †）。为确保公平比较，所有消融研究均使用相同的骨干网络、LoRA 秩、训练计划、随机种子和相机轨迹。它们仅在条件输入和去噪引导方式上有所不同。实现细节、评估协议和对象级指标分别列于附录 A、B.1 和 B.3 中。

paragraphs.en: We claim in Section 3.1 that a blurry but geometrically aligned condition is better than a sharp but misaligned one. Table 3 tests this on the unseen split by measuring both properties of each conditioning render against the ground truth. Alignment is measured by zero-mean normalized cross-correlation (ZNCC) and the similarity of DINO features ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) at the same location. Sharpness is measured by the Laplacian variance relative to the ground truth. The two renders are opposite: the synthesizer render is the blurriest but the best aligned, while the point-cloud render is sharp but poorly aligned. Despite its blur, the synthesizer render conditions the diffusion model better (Table 2 ). The blur of the condition does not remain in the output: generations from the two renders reach the same sharpness (Appendix C.2 ), which indicates that the diffusion model restores the details missing from the condition. The synthesizer render is also much cheaper to compute than depth estimation and point-cloud rendering (Table 3 ).

paragraphs.en: Confidence gating and ARC both assume that the confidence of Eq. 4 indicates where the render is correct. Fig. 5 tests this assumption without committing to a threshold. We sort the windows of the generated videos by confidence and plot the error of the most confident windows against the ground truth as a function of how many are kept. paragraphs.en: LEGO conditions a video diffusion model on the render of a learned view synthesizer, not a point-cloud reconstruction, on one criterion: a condition should be aligned before it is sharp, because the generator restores detail far more readily than it corrects misplaced content. The design has three practical advantages. It is lifting-free, with no depth estimation, point cloud, or reprojection at any stage. Its confidence comes free from the synthesizer’s correspondence distribution and drives both the gating and a training-free guidance that replaces a bias the generator must be trained with. And the frozen synthesizer enters only through its render and confidence, so the same weights carry over to new scenes and recordings without retraining, and a stronger synthesizer can be dropped in as one appears. The synthesizer supplies the structure of the view, and the diffusion model its detail.
paragraphs.zh: LEGO 将视频扩散模型的条件设定为已学习视图合成器的渲染结果，而非点云重建，且仅基于一个标准：条件必须在内容清晰前就已对齐，因为生成器恢复细节的能力远强于纠正错误位置内容的能力。 该设计具有三个实际优势。 它无需提升操作，在任何阶段都不需要深度估计、点云或重投影。 其置信度独立于合成器的对应关系分布，并驱动了门控机制以及一种无需训练的引导机制，从而替代了生成器必须通过训练才能具备的偏见。 此外，冻结的合成器仅通过其渲染结果和置信度被引入，因此相同的权重可以直接应用于新场景和录像而无需重新训练；一旦有更强的合成器出现，也可以直接替换使用。 合成器提供视图的结构，而扩散模型则为其添加细节。

paragraphs.en: F F has the architecture of the released scene-level LVSM decoder ( Jin et al., 2025 ) : 24 transformer blocks of width 768 with 12 heads and patch size 8. Source tokens carry RGB and the six Plücker channels; target tokens carry the six ray channels only. We initialize from the published checkpoint and fine-tune all weights on Ego-Exo4D at 448 × 448 448{\times}448 egocentric and 448 × 784 448{\times}784 exocentric resolution, with an ℓ 2 \ell_{2} loss and an LPIPS loss weighted by 0.5. Training uses AdamW with learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 2{\times}10^{-5} , cosine decay with 500 warm-up steps, a global batch size of 16, and 10k steps, about 3.5 hours on 4 H200 GPUs. The confidence of Eq. 4 is read from the attention of the last 8 layers, averaged over heads, with the softmax restricted to exocentric keys, and average-pooled 2 × 2 2{\times}2 to the token grid of the generator ( 28 × 28 28{\times}28 egocentric queries).
paragraphs.zh: F F 采用已发布的场景级 LVSM 解码器（Jin et al., 2025）的架构：包含 24 个宽度为 768、具有 12 个头和 8 的块大小的 transformer 模块。 源 token 携带 RGB 和六个普吕克通道；目标 token 仅携带六个射线通道。 我们从已发布的检查点开始初始化，并在 Ego-Exo4D 数据集上对所有权重进行微调，分辨率为 448 × 448 448{\times}448 的以自我为中心视角和 448 × 784 448{\times}784 的以外为中心视角，使用 ℓ₂ \ell_{2} 损失和权重为 0.5 的 LPIPS 损失。 训练使用 AdamW，学习率为 2 × 10⁻⁵ 2{\times}10^{-5}，采用余弦退火并设置 500 个预热步数，全局批量大小为 16，训练步数为 10k，在 4 块 H200 GPU 上大约需要 3.5 小时。 公式 4 中的置信度来自最后 8 层的注意力机制，对各头取平均，并将 softmax 限制在以外为中心的键上，然后以 2 × 2 2{\times}2 的平均池化方式映射到生成器的 token 网格（28 × 28 28{\times}28 的以自我为中心的查询）。

sents.en: F F has the architecture of the released scene-level LVSM decoder ( Jin et al., 2025 ) : 24 transformer blocks of width 768 with 12 heads and patch size 8.
sents.zh: F F 采用已发布的场景级 LVSM 解码器（Jin et al., 2025）的架构：包含 24 个宽度为 768、具有 12 个头和 8 的块大小的 transformer 模块。

sents.en: Source tokens carry RGB and the six Plücker channels; target tokens carry the six ray channels only.
sents.zh: 源 token 携带 RGB 和六个普吕克通道；目标 token 仅携带六个射线通道。

sents.en: We initialize from the published checkpoint and fine-tune all weights on Ego-Exo4D at 448 × 448 448{\times}448 egocentric and 448 × 784 448{\times}784 exocentric resolution, with an ℓ 2 \ell_{2} loss and an LPIPS loss weighted by 0.5.
sents.zh: 我们从已发布的检查点开始初始化，并在 Ego-Exo4D 数据集上对所有权重进行微调，分辨率为 448 × 448 448{\times}448 的以自我为中心视角和 448 × 784 448{\times}784 的以外为中心视角，使用 ℓ₂ \ell_{2} 损失和权重为 0.5 的 LPIPS 损失。

sents.en: Training uses AdamW with learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 2{\times}10^{-5} , cosine decay with 500 warm-up steps, a global batch size of 16, and 10k steps, about 3.5 hours on 4 H200 GPUs.
sents.zh: 训练使用 AdamW，学习率为 2 × 10⁻⁵ 2{\times}10^{-5}，采用余弦退火并设置 500 个预热步数，全局批量大小为 16，训练步数为 10k，在 4 块 H200 GPU 上大约需要 3.5 小时。

sents.en: The confidence of Eq. 4 is read from the attention of the last 8 layers, averaged over heads, with the softmax restricted to exocentric keys, and average-pooled 2 × 2 2{\times}2 to the token grid of the generator ( 28 × 28 28{\times}28 egocentric queries).
sents.zh: 公式 4 中的置信度来自最后 8 层的注意力机制，对各头取平均，并将 softmax 限制在以外为中心的键上，然后以 2 × 2 2{\times}2 的平均池化方式映射到生成器的 token 网格（28 × 28 28{\times}28 的以自我为中心的查询）。

paragraphs.en: The backbone is Wan2.1-I2V-14B at 480P ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , fine-tuned with LoRA of rank 256 and α = 256 \alpha{=}256 on a 49 × 448 × 1232 49{\times}448{\times}1232 canvas, the exocentric frame (784 wide) concatenated with the egocentric frame. Training runs for 20k steps with learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 2{\times}10^{-5} , bf16, a batch size of 1 per GPU on 4 H200 GPUs, and seed 42; all ablations share this recipe. The backbone is also conditioned on a text prompt, at training and at inference alike, as in EgoX. On Ego-Exo4D we use the prompts released with the benchmark. EgoHumans and Nymeria come with none, so we generate one for every test clip from eight exocentric frames, following the system prompt of EgoX and its two-block format, an [Exo view] description of the scene followed by an [Ego view] description of the target viewpoint. We replace only the vision-language model, GPT-4o in EgoX, with the open Qwen2.5-VL ( Bai et al., 2025b ) , and match the prompt length to the distribution of the released Ego-Exo4D prompts. At inference both methods receive the same prompt for a given clip. Inference uses 50 denoising steps with classifier-free guidance 5.0. Confidence gating uses k = 16 k{=}16 and τ = 0.3 \tau{=}0.3 on the synthesizer’s 56 × 56 56{\times}56 query grid. ARC applies Eq. 6 after each denoising step during the first 80% of the schedule ( h = 0.8 h{=}0.8 ), with the noise level floored at 0.05. The ARC hyperparameters ( h h and the squared weighting) were chosen on the unseen split, since Ego-Exo4D provides no separate validation split.
paragraphs.zh: 主干模型为 Wan2.1-I2V-14B（分辨率 480P）（Wan 等，2025），在 49 × 448 × 1232 的画布上，使用秩为 256、α = 256 的 LoRA 进行微调；该画布由外视角帧（宽度为 784）与内视角帧拼接而成。 训练持续 20,000 步，学习率为 2 × 10⁻⁵，使用 bf16 精度、每 GPU 1 个批次的批量大小，在 4 块 H200 GPU 上运行，随机种子为 42；所有消融实验均沿用此训练方案。 与 EgoX 类似，该模型的主干部分在训练和推理阶段均会根据文本提示进行条件约束。 在 Ego-Exo4D 数据集上，我们使用随基准测试一同发布的提示词。 EgoHumans 和 Nymeria 未提供提示词，因此我们根据八个外视角帧为每个测试片段生成一个提示词，遵循 EgoX 的系统提示及其双模块格式：先描述场景的[外视角]，再描述目标视角的[内视角]。 我们仅将 EgoX 中的视觉语言模型（GPT-4o）替换为开源的 Qwen2.5-VL（Bai 等，2025b），并将提示词长度与已发布的 Ego-Exo4D 提示词分布相匹配。 在推理阶段，对于给定的片段，两种方法均接收相同的提示词。 推理过程使用 50 步去噪操作，并配合无分类器引导（系数为 5.0）。 置信度门控机制在合成器的 56 × 56 查询网格上设置 k = 16 和 τ = 0.3。 ARC 在训练进度的前 80%（即 h = 0.8）期间，于每一步去噪后应用公式 6，并将噪声水平限制在最低 0.05。 ARC 的超参数（h 和平方权重）是在未见过的数据分割集上选择的，因为 Ego-Exo4D 未提供独立的验证集。

paragraphs.en: To compare fairly with EgoX ( Kang et al., 2026 ) , we match its training and inference configuration wherever the released code specifies it: backbone checkpoint, LoRA rank and alpha, canvas resolution, optimizer, learning rate, precision, batch size, seed, noising and loss masks, sampler, number of denoising steps, guidance scale, and frame count. The GGA ablation uses the official implementation of the geometry-guided attention bias, and we verified that the bias is applied identically at training and inference. Two differences remain. We train for 20k steps with a batch size of 1 per GPU on 4 H200 GPUs for about four days, whereas EgoX trains with the same batch size on 8 H200 GPUs for about one day. Second, since the evaluation code is not public, metrics are our own implementation. Under our implementation (Appendix B.2 ), the released checkpoint scores 15.57 (16.05) dB PSNR on seen and 13.53 (14.38) dB on unseen scenes, where the numbers in parentheses are those reported in Kang et al. (2026) .
paragraphs.zh: 为了与 EgoX（Kang 等人，2026）进行公平比较，我们在已发布代码明确指定的所有方面，均匹配其训练和推理配置：主干模型检查点、LoRA 秩和 alpha、画布分辨率、优化器、学习率、精度、批量大小、种子、噪声和损失掩码、采样器、去噪步数、引导缩放因子以及帧数。 GGA 消融研究使用了基于几何引导的注意力偏置的官方实现，并且我们已验证该偏置在训练和推理阶段均以完全相同的方式应用。但仍存在两个差异。 我们在 4 块 H200 GPU 上以每块 GPU 1 的批量大小训练了 2 万步，耗时约四天；而 EgoX 则以相同的批量大小在 8 块 H200 GPU 上训练了约一天。 其次，由于评估代码并非公开，相关指标由我们自己实现。 在我们的实现中（附录 B.2），已发布的检查点在已见场景上的 PSNR 得分为 15.57（16.05）dB，在未见场景上为 13.53（14.38）dB，其中括号内的数字为 Kang 等人（2026）所报告的数值。

paragraphs.en: FVD ( Unterthiner et al., 2018 ) is computed with the cd-fvd implementation ( Ge et al., 2024 ) on the egocentric half: I3D features of one 16-frame sample per video, resized to 224 × 224 224{\times}224 , compared between the generated and ground-truth clips of a split. Dynamic degree is a per-clip binary decision based on RAFT optical flow; we keep the VBench sampling and count rule and apply the same flow threshold to every method.

paragraphs.en: For the analysis of the conditioning renders, sharpness is the variance of the Laplacian response of a frame on a region Ω \Omega , reported as the ratio to the ground-truth frame on the same region. Ω \Omega is the valid egocentric image circle, or, for point-cloud renders, the rendered pixels eroded by 3 px. Chroma is the mean chroma magnitude inside the valid image circle, reported as the ratio of the generated to the ground-truth video. Both ratios are averaged over the 13 frames aligned with the latent frames ( t = 0 , 4 , … , 48 t{=}0,4,\ldots,48 ) and over clips; a value of 1 means the same amount as the ground truth.

paragraphs.en: EgoX ( Kang et al., 2026 ) reports three object-level metrics: LocErr , the distance between the bounding-box centers of matched objects in the generated and ground-truth frames; IoU , the overlap of their bounding boxes; and Contour , the agreement of their shapes. Computing them requires a detection and matching pipeline that is not part of the public release. We therefore fix one protocol, validate it against the published numbers, and apply it unchanged to all methods.
paragraphs.zh: EgoX（Kang 等人，2026）报告了三个对象级指标：LocErr，即生成帧与真实帧中匹配对象边界框中心之间的距离；IoU，即它们边界框的重叠度；以及 Contour，即它们形状的吻合度。 计算这些指标需要一个检测与匹配流程，但该流程并未包含在公开版本中。 因此，我们固定一种协议，用已公布的数值对其进行验证，并原封不动地将其应用于所有方法。

paragraphs.en: Objects are segmented and tracked with SAM 2 ( Ravi et al., 2025 ) on the generated and the ground-truth video independently, using automatic mask generation on the first frame (32 points per side, seed boxes of at least 32 px, mask regions of at least 2000 px 2 ). LocErr and IoU are computed on the matched boxes and averaged per clip and then over clips. paragraphs.en: This subsection describes how the test clips of EgoHumans and Nymeria are selected and how their videos are prepared for evaluation. Both datasets record the egocentric view with Project Aria glasses, so the egocentric camera is the same fisheye model as in Ego-Exo4D.
paragraphs.zh: 本小节介绍了如何挑选 EgoHumans 和 Nymeria 的测试片段，以及如何为评估准备这些视频。 这两个数据集都使用 Project Aria 眼镜记录第一人称视角，因此其第一人称摄像头与 Ego-Exo4D 中使用的鱼眼镜头型号相同。

paragraphs.en: This dataset ( Khirodkar et al., 2023 ) records multi-person activities with several exocentric cameras and is not used for training. We select 200 clips of 49 frames, distributed evenly over the seven activity scenarios and drawn from multiple takes per scenario. Within a take, the wearer and the starting frame are sampled at regular intervals with a fixed seed. For each clip we use a single exocentric camera, the one in which the wearer is closest to the image center. The exocentric frames are resized and center-cropped to the canvas resolution, and the egocentric frames are the raw fisheye recordings, as in Ego-Exo4D.
paragraphs.zh: 该数据集（Khirodkar 等人，2023）使用多个外视角摄像头记录了多人活动，且未用于训练。 我们选择了 200 个片段，每个片段包含 49 帧，这些片段均匀分布在七个活动场景中，并来自每个场景的多次拍摄。 在一次拍摄中，佩戴者和起始帧以固定种子值按固定间隔进行采样。 对于每个片段，我们使用单个外视角摄像头，即佩戴者距离图像中心最近的摄像头。 外视角帧被调整大小并中心裁剪至画布分辨率，而内视角帧则采用原始鱼眼录制，与 Ego-Exo4D 中的做法一致。

paragraphs.en: This dataset ( Ma et al., 2024 ) records a participant and an observer, both wearing Aria glasses, and is not used for training. The observer takes the role of the exocentric camera. Since the observer moves, we use only 49-frame windows in which the observer camera is effectively static, with at most 4 cm of translation and 2.5 ∘ 2.5^{\circ} of rotation. We further require that the participant’s head is visible in the observer’s view throughout the window, which we check by projecting the participant’s camera center into the observer’s frame and by detecting a person at the projected location. From the resulting pool we select 200 clips over 26 sequences, balancing the number of clips per sequence. The observer’s fisheye frames are undistorted to a pinhole camera with a focal length of 260 pixels and cropped to the canvas resolution.
paragraphs.zh: 该数据集（Ma et al., 2024）记录了一名参与者和一名观察者，两者均佩戴着 Aria 眼镜，且未用于训练。 观察者扮演外心相机的角色。 由于观察者会移动，我们仅使用包含观察者相机实际静止的 49 帧窗口，其平移最多为 4 厘米，旋转最多为 2.5°。 我们还要求参与者的头部在整个窗口期间始终出现在观察者的视野中，我们通过将参与者相机的中心投影到观察者的图像帧中，并在投影位置检测到人来实现这一检查。 我们从由此得到的候选池中选出 26 个序列中的 200 个片段，并平衡每个序列的片段数量。 观察者的鱼眼图像帧被校正为焦距为 260 像素的小孔相机图像，并裁剪至画布分辨率。

paragraphs.en: The mechanism is an asymmetry between the two models. The synthesizer is a regression model, so under correspondence uncertainty it tends toward a conditional mean, in which chroma averages toward gray while luminance structure largely survives. The generator under the same uncertainty samples a plausible mode, and its color prior, acquired at pretraining scale and adapted here only through a low-rank update, is unaffected by the synthesizer’s collapse. Such conditioning over-reliance is documented for image-to-video models ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) . The standard remedy, for it and for the exposure bias, is to degrade or noise-augment the conditioning during training ( Ho et al., 2022 ; Blattmann et al., 2023 ) . Color drift is itself a known signature of conditioning on model-produced imagery ( Li et al., 2026 ) . FVD is particularly sensitive to such per-frame appearance statistics ( Ge et al., 2024 ) , which accounts for part of the unseen FVD gap in Table 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 这种机制源于两个模型之间的不对称性。 合成器是一个回归模型，因此在对应关系存在不确定性时，它会倾向于条件均值：此时色度会向灰色趋近，而亮度结构则基本得以保留。 在相同的不确定性条件下，生成器会采样一个合理的模式；其颜色先验是在预训练阶段获得的，且在此处仅通过低秩更新进行调整，因此不受合成器坍缩的影响。 图像到视频模型中存在这种对条件信息的过度依赖现象（Zhao et al., 2024）。 针对这一问题以及曝光偏差问题的标准解决方案是，在训练过程中对条件信息进行降级或添加噪声增强（Ho et al., 2022; Blattmann et al., 2023）。 颜色漂移本身已被证实是模型生成图像作为条件输入时的典型特征（Li et al., 2026）。 FVD 对每帧的外观统计特征尤为敏感（Ge et al., 2024），这也是表 2 中部分未观察到的 FVD 差异的原因。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 reports the cost of generating one clip on a single H200 GPU, averaged over the 100 clips. Generation covers the denoising loop together with the encoding and decoding around it, and assumes that the condition is already built. End-to-end adds the cost of building the condition. During denoising, the two methods differ only in the bias they apply. GGA builds a dense attention bias over the whole canvas and reapplies it in every transformer block, which adds 252 ms to each forward pass. ARC instead updates the egocentric part of the clean estimate once per step, in 2.7 ms. The larger difference is upstream. Building our condition takes 4.7 s per clip, against 69.2 s for depth estimation and point-cloud rendering (Table 3 ). Overall, LEGO generates a clip faster than EgoX and uses slightly less memory.

paragraphs.en: LEGO inherits the limitations of the view synthesizer. F F renders each frame independently from a single exocentric frame, so it cannot recover content that the frame does not show (Fig. 8 ), and it blurs where the correspondence is uncertain. Its colors also collapse on unfamiliar scenes (Section C.2 ). The pipeline is lifting-free but still requires the camera poses of both views. Since F F is frozen and enters only through the conditioning input and the confidence map, a stronger feed-forward view synthesizer can replace it without changing the diffusion model or ARC.
paragraphs.zh: LEGO 继承了视图合成器的局限性。 F F 从单个外心帧独立渲染每一帧，因此无法恢复帧中未显示的内容（图 8），并且在对应关系不确定的区域会出现模糊。 在陌生场景中，其颜色也会失效（C.2 节）。 该流程无需抬升操作，但仍需要两个视图的相机姿态。 由于 F F 是固定的，且仅通过条件输入和置信度图进行输入，因此可以用一个更强大的前向视图合成器替代它，而无需更改扩散模型或 ARC。

paragraphs.en: Across the examples, the two methods fail in the way described in Section 4 . EgoX reproduces content sharply at the wrong position, which is most visible for the hands and for objects close to the camera. LEGO keeps the scene where the ground truth places it and lets the diffusion model add the details that its condition does not carry. The same holds on EgoHumans and Nymeria. The remaining errors of LEGO are softer details and, on unseen scenes, less saturated colors (Section C.2 ).
